items.title: Evolutionary genomics of ancient and endangered Achnatherum breviaristatum on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau
items.author: Wenli Chen
items.content: A comparative genomics study on grasses from the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau reveals how demographic decline, reduced clonal reproduction, and Pleistocene climate shifts have driven low diversity in an endangered endemic species, while reduced genetic load may have enabled its persistence.

items.title: Genome-wide analyses reveal recent diversification and hidden diversity in Amazonian howler monkeys, including two new species
items.author: Jean P. Boubli
items.content: Genome-wide analysis of 11 howler monkey species reveals recent Amazonian diversification, identifies two new species, and supports a transAndean origin, uncovering hidden diversity and reinforcing conservation amid rapid tropical habitat loss.
